meta.name: Puzzle 03 — Glider Strike
meta.description: SOLO PUZZLE. A stable Block sits in the center of the dish. Goal: destroy it in ≤ 2 moves using a Glider. Teaches spaceship travel + deliberate collision targeting.
meta.rules: Solo mode. Prompt: 'Destroy the specimen in 2 moves.' Win check: block cells (original X cells) all gone at end.
questions: Does a glider hitting a block from NW actually destroy it?
Is 2 moves the right budget (too easy / too hard)?
Can the player aim the glider correctly with ghost preview?

moves.note: Player launches a glider from NW, aimed at the block.
